sanskrit_verse: अनाच्छेद्यकरास् तेषां प्रदद्याद् गृहभूमिकाः । मुक्ता भाव्याश् च नृपतिर् लेखयित्वा स्वशासनैः ॥
transliteration: anācchhedya-karās teṣāṃ pradadyād gṛha-bhūmikāḥ | muktā bhāvyāś ca nṛpatiḥ lekhayitvā sva-śāsanaiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The ruler shall bestow dwelling lands upon those whose hands are unsevered, and having inscribed their names, shall declare them free from liability and future obligation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign's capacity to allocate resources for existential restoration.
Causation is determined by bodily integrity as a marker of unbroken agency.
Capacity-based responsibility requires physical and social enablement prior to expectation.
Restoration logic begins with securing foundational needs—dwelling, identity, and freedom from debt.
Consciousness alignment occurs when material security precedes civic duty.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that before any judicial inquiry or assignment of civic duty, the State must affirmatively ensure that the individual possesses both physical capacity and residential stability. The court must verify that land allocation records exist and that no outstanding liabilities encumber the citizen’s status. This serves as a threshold condition for all higher legal proceedings involving personal accountability.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that without secure habitation and bodily integrity, no valid action can proceed. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that until these conditions are fulfilled, the sequence of dharma-aligned behavior cannot manifest. Responsibility is proportional only after capacity has been restored. There is no punitive value in enforcing obligations where foundational supports are absent; hence, enforcement is purely restorative.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Land Allocation Protocol: Ensure every citizen capable of labor receives a designated plot for residence and sustenance.
Ledger Enrollment Process: Officially register each individual within the sovereign's administrative system to establish visibility and identity clarity.
Liability Discharge Mechanism: Clear prior debts or obligations through sovereign decree once foundational needs are secured.
Duty Enablement Sequence: Only after domicile and discharge may civic responsibilities be lawfully assumed.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from the foundation of being, not from fear or scarcity. Justice is executed not by punishment but by completion. The State exists to restore consciousness, not to constrain it. Thus is Dharma fulfilled; thus is reality aligned.
